translationRepairs: On gengshen the late Yingzong—temple name Rui—was interred at Yuling.
On gengshen the late Yingzong—posthumous name Rui—was interred at Yuling.
睿皇帝 is Yingzong's posthumous designation; 英宗 is the temple name. The idiomatic English wrongly calls Rui a temple name. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
On the day dingsi the sacrifice of release was offered to the Master Confucius.
On the day dingsi the shidian sacrifice was offered to the Master Confucius.
釋奠 is the classical shidian/libation sacrifice to Confucius, not a 'sacrifice of release'. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
In the eighth month, on dingsi, he attacked Ningxia; Jiao Zheng, regional commander, was killed in action.
In the eighth month, on dingsi, he attacked Ningxia; Jiao Zheng, regional military commissioner, was killed in action.
都指揮 is a Regional Military Commissioner, not 總兵官 (regional commander). The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
On xinhai the Kaicheng rebel Man Jun rose; Ren Shou, Baron of Ningyuan and Shaanxi supreme commander, and Chen Jia, regional commander and supreme censor, marched against him.
On xinhai the Kaicheng rebel Man Jun rose; Ren Shou, Baron of Ningyuan and Shaanxi regional commander, and Chen Jia, grand coordinator and censor-in-chief, marched against him.
巡撫都御史 is Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief, not 'regional commander and supreme censor'. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
In the eleventh month, on guimao, refugees from Jing and Xiang rebelled; Xiang Zhong took overall command in Henan, Huguang, Jing, and Xiang to suppress them.
In the eleventh month, on guiwei, refugees from Jing and Xiang rebelled; Xiang Zhong took overall command in Henan, Huguang, Jing, and Xiang to suppress them.
The source date is 癸未 (guiwei), not 癸卯 (guimao). The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Yu Zijun, Yan-sui grand coordinator and regional commander, defeated Qojasan at Yulin Stream.
In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Yu Zijun, Yan-sui grand coordinator and censor-in-chief, defeated Qojasan at Yulin Stream.
巡撫延綏都御史 is Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief, not regional commander. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
